## Context
RP-01 proposes replacing Rebar’s bespoke structured-output orchestration with authoritative Pydantic AI seams. The replacement is not behavior-preserving by default: historical bugs encode hard-won behavior around deterministic repair and extraction, refusal/truncation handling, retry and tool/request limits, per-operation output budgets, provider fallback, usage accounting, telemetry, and failure taxonomy. Before RP-01 can be approved or ticketized, reconstruct the behavioral contract from both ticket history and the existing test suite and exercise Pydantic AI 1.107.2 offline. A behavior may be preserved or intentionally changed, but no observed delta may be accidental or left to the implementer.

## Plan
- Deduplicate ticket-derived scenarios with behavioral cases from the structured runner, failure-matrix, budget, timeout, and agent-call seam test suites.
- Record each scenario’s current observable behavior and its authoritative ticket/test evidence.
- Extend the ignored local FunctionModel probe to exercise Pydantic AI 1.107.2 native output, prompted output, output retry, usage limits, FallbackModel predicates, provider errors, truncation/refusal, telemetry, and artifact-capture feasibility without live model calls.
- Classify each scenario as preserve, intentionally change, or requiring an explicit maintainer decision; do not infer an invariant from the current implementation alone.
- Record the resulting evidence and experiment outputs in the local `.joe-janitor/` recovery archive and summarize the decision matrix on this ticket.

## Verification
This is an investigation task. The smallest sufficient tier is an in-process integration probe using the real Pydantic AI 1.107.2 Agent/FunctionModel/output/limits/hooks seams while mocking only provider transport. The oracle is the exact call count, request mode, accepted semantic output, exception class, usage/accounting fields, and captured telemetry for each predeclared scenario. Existing unit tests provide the current-Rebar side of the comparison.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A deduplicated matrix maps every material ticket-derived and test-derived scenario to exact ticket aliases and test node or source locations.
- [ ] The matrix states current Rebar behavior and observed Pydantic AI 1.107.2 behavior for each scenario.
- [ ] Every outcome difference is labeled preserve, intentionally change, or explicit decision required; no difference is silently inherited from either implementation.
- [ ] The offline probe executes the real Pydantic AI output/retry/fallback/limits/hook seams and records exact observable oracles without a live model call.
- [ ] A concise RP-01 research note and the probe are stored beside the recovered janitor artifacts under `.joe-janitor/`.
- [ ] [operator-attested] A ticket comment records the artifact paths, probe command and result, scenario coverage totals, and the next unresolved behavior decision.
